title: A tuft of grass (a producer)
why: Look at how many thin green blades catch sunlight, because this is where the food chain starts.
credit: “Realistics grass 06” by POLYSCAN, CC BY 4.0, via Sketchfab

title: A grasshopper (a herbivore)
why: Look at its strong back legs and its mouth, made for eating plants and for jumping away from danger.
credit: “Grasshopper” by Chaitanya Krishnan, CC BY 4.0, via Sketchfab

title: A green tree frog (a predator)
why: Look at its big eyes and wide mouth, and think about which small animals it could catch and eat.
credit: “CC0 モリアオガエル 🐸 ♂ Forest Green Tree Frog” by ffish.asia / floraZia.com, CC0, via Sketchfab
